thread.title: SPYV, DUSL: Big ETF Inflows

author: BNK Invest
title: SPYV, DUSL: Big ETF Inflows
text:
Shutterstock photo Comparing units outstanding versus one week ago at the coverage universe of ETFs at ETF Channel, the biggest inflow was seen in the SPDR Portfolio S&P 500 Value ETF ( SPYV ), which added 9,500,000 units, or a 11.8% increase week over week. Among the largest underlying components of SPYV, in morning trading today Apple ( AAPL ) is down about 0.5%, and JP Morgan Chase ( JPM ) is lower by about 0.1%.
And on a percentage change basis, the ETF with the biggest increase in inflows was the Daily Industrials Bull 3X Shares ( DUSL ), which added 50,000 units, for a 33.3% increase in outstanding units.
